To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
DNAM‐ 1, a NK receptor, plays a major role in Vγ9Vγ2 T‐cell cytolytic activity against HCC.
DNAM‐ 1 is involved in γδ T cell cytotoxicity against human hepatocellular cancer cells.
DNAM‐‐1 is a major activating NK receptor expressed by Vγδ2 T cells and that it is required to trigger their cytolytic activity against hepatocellular carcinoma.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the identification of a new receptor‐ligand system that may play a role in the interaction of HCC cells with Vγ9V δ2 T cells, and that may be exploited for the development of new immunotherapeutic approaches against HCC.
the identification of the DNAM‐1/Nectin‐like 5 pathway as a new mechanism involved in γδ T cell‐mediated lysis of HHC.
a previously unknown mechanism of recognition of tumor cells by Vγ9δ2 T cells and provides new insights into the mechanisms of γδ T‐mediated antitumor activity
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
DNAM‐ 1, in the presence of NKG2D, is involved in Vγ9Vγ2 T‐cell cytolytic activity against HCC.
Vγ9Vγ2 T cells can be efficiently activated by HCC cells via DNAM‐1 in a Nectin‐5‐dependent manner, and this interaction is able to cooperate with NKG2D in the killing of tumor cells.
DNAM‐ and NKG2‐dependent pathways are both involved in the killing of tumor cells by γδ T lymphocytes, and that these pathways are not redundant but rather synergistic.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
DNAM‐ 1 plays a role in Vγ9V δ2 T‐cell cytolytic activity against HCC cells and that this receptor can act in concert with NKG2D.
the DNAM‐1/Nectin‐like5 axis is involved in Vγ9V δ2 T‐cell cytolytic function against HCC.
DNAM‐ 1 plays a role in Vγ9V δ2 T‐cell killing of HCC and that Nectin ‐like‐5 may be the ligand of DNAX accessory molecule ‐1 on the HCC cell surface.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the DNAM‐1/Nectin‐like-5 axis is a major player in the recognition of HCC cells by Vγ9δ2 T cells, and that DNAM‐ 1 and NKG‐2D can synergize in γδ T-cell cytotoxicity against tumor cells.
DNAM‐ 1 plays a key role in the cytotoxicity of Vγ9V δ2 T lymphocytes against HCC cells.
DNAM‐ 1, in addition to its known role in natural killer cell cytotoxicity, also plays a role in Vγ9V δ2 T‐cell cytolytic activity.
